title: Creative Lead
description:
FlytBase

Lead and make the creative work that makes Physical AI impossible to ignore—from brand systems and campaigns to the next great visual idea.

Design

Pune, India

Full-time

  

### **What We Do**

FlytBase is the global category leader in Physical AI for Large sites. FlytBase’s drone autonomy platform powers mission-critical operations across 400+ enterprise sites in 70+ countries. Our customers include Fortune 500 leaders such as Shell, CSX, UK Police, Airbus, Anglo American, Dole, and Statnett. FlytBase has its presence in 70+ countries with offices in the US and Pune, India. FlytBase is building the nervous system for large industrial sites. We operate at AI speed - autonomy and intelligence at our core. Our lean team thrives in a high-agency, high-velocity environment where AI is not a side project; it is the operating system for how we think, build, and grow.

### **The Role**

You’ll lead FlytBase’s Creative Team while staying close to the work. You’ll set the creative bar, shape the brief, challenge the first idea, and then get your hands dirty making the thing—with designers, writers, video creators, and AI tools. This is not a review-only leadership role. We need someone with elite taste who can turn complex drone autonomy and Physical AI into clear, memorable, high-impact creative. You’ll work across brand, product marketing, demand generation, events, sales, and executive communications. Some days you’ll be defining the visual direction for a global campaign. Other days you’ll be storyboarding a product video, rebuilding a pitch deck, directing a photoshoot, or prototyping ten concepts with AI before lunch. You’ll help the team move faster without lowering the bar—and build the systems that make great work repeatable.

### **What You'll Own**

• Set the creative direction and quality bar across FlytBase’s brand, campaigns, product storytelling, and customer-facing work • Lead, coach, and develop the Creative Team through clear briefs, sharp feedback, and hands-on collaboration • Create and direct campaign concepts across visual design, motion, video, social, web, events, and sales materials • Translate complex drone autonomy, enterprise software, and Physical AI into work people understand and remember • Partner with marketing, product, sales, and leadership to turn business goals into strong creative briefs and outcomes • Build and evolve brand systems, templates, guidelines, and workflows that help the team ship consistently at speed • Use generative AI, automation, and emerging creative tools as core parts of the creative process—not occasional experiments • Establish a high-velocity review process that protects quality without creating approval bottlenecks • Bring outside inspiration, new formats, and ambitious creative thinking into how FlytBase shows up globally • Measure creative impact through audience response, campaign performance, clarity, and business results—not subjective applause alone

### **Best Suited For**

• Creative leaders who still make, direct, edit, prototype, and present—not just delegate • Demonstrated taste across brand, campaign, digital, motion, video, or editorial work, with a portfolio that shows range and judgment • Experience leading a small, high-output creative team or multidisciplinary project group • Strong ability to simplify technical, abstract, or enterprise concepts into compelling stories and visuals • AI-native creators who use generative tools to expand ideas, accelerate production, and raise the quality bar • Comfortable partnering with marketers, product teams, sales leaders, and executives across a global business • Someone who can give precise feedback, defend a strong point of view, and change direction when the work demands it

### **What Makes You a Flyter**

• Radical ownership: You take a creative problem from vague ask to shipped outcome without waiting for perfect instructions. • High standards, low ego: You care deeply about the work, invite challenge, and make the idea better instead of protecting authorship. • Maker-leader: You lead by creating alongside the team and can jump from strategy to a Figma file, edit timeline, or AI prototype. • Velocity with judgment: You know when to polish, when to ship, and when the first idea needs to be thrown out. • Clear candor: You give feedback people can use and say what is not working before it becomes expensive. • Systems thinking: You build creative processes that make a lean team faster, more consistent, and more ambitious.

### **What We Don't Want**

• Managers who believe creative leadership means assigning tasks and approving final files from a distance. • Portfolio decorators whose work looks polished but says little, solves no clear problem, or cannot explain the decisions behind it. • People who wait for a complete brief, a large team, or the latest tool before making progress. • Creators who treat AI as a shortcut or novelty instead of learning how it changes ideation, production, and creative operations. • Perfectionists who turn every deliverable into a slow, subjective approval cycle. • Specialists unwilling to work across formats, from a campaign idea and product video to a sales deck or event experience.

### **Why FlytBase?**

• Physical AI, not pretend innovation: Your work will make a new category—drone autonomy for large industrial sites—understandable and desirable. • Global creative surface area: Shape how FlytBase shows up across 400+ enterprise sites in 70+ countries, with customers including Shell, CSX, Airbus, and Anglo American. • Real ownership: You’ll define the creative operating model, influence the brand, and raise the bar through work—not manage from the sidelines. • AI at the core: Build an AI-native creative practice where tools, workflows, and systems let a lean team produce outsized work at speed. • In-person energy in Pune: Work closely with a sharp, ambitious Creative Team and cross-functional partners who value direct feedback and fast iteration. • Mazaa Aayega: You’ll get to make work for a category that is still being defined, with room to take big swings and see your ideas deployed in the real world.

### **The Perks**

• High agency team and sense of purpose • International Travel - we travel to all 6 continents (sorry, no business in Antarctica yet) • Thought leadership & public speaking opportunities at online & physical events • No-cap budget for AI tools, courses, or experiments • Latest tech stack and tools - whatever helps you move faster • Unlimited leave policy & flexible working hours (no punch-in/out) • A damn good team to work with

### **Who You'll Work With**

You’ll work directly with the Creative Team and partner closely with marketing, product, sales, and leadership. The work will span brand building, product storytelling, demand generation, customer communications, and global events.

### **Ready to Fly?**

If you have the taste to know what great looks like—and the hands-on range to help make it—show us the work you’re proud of and tell us how you made it happen.

title: Senior Manager – Content and Training
description:
**Job Information**
-------------------

* Work Experience 12-15 years

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Job Title:** **Senior Manager – Content and Training** 
**Location: Pune** 
**Travel: As per the project need**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Position Overview:**

Vocational education is now part of school learning from Grade 6. NEP 2020 and NCF-SE 2023 set the direction, and CBSE has started Kaushal Bodh for Grades 6–8 and Kaushal Vikas for Grades 9–10.

Done well, children learn by building, growing, cooking and repairing. They understand how things work, respect all kinds of work, and see more choices for their future. Done badly, it becomes one more period on the timetable.

Two things decide which one happens: how well teachers are prepared, and whether their material works in a real classroom. This role builds both as one system, and helps states use it at scale.

  

**Purpose of the role:**

You will find the needs that keep coming up across states, build solutions many states can use, and help each state adapt them without losing what makes them work. You will always look for ways to reach more teachers with less manual effort, using technology where it helps and keeping people where they matter most.

You will set the standard for how LAHI prepares teachers and builds learning material, and lead a small team that designs training and material.

**What you will do:**

* Prepare teachers and trainers. Decide what teachers, trainers, mentors and master trainers should be able to do, and build the path to get there. People move up by showing they can do the work, not by attending. Build a training cascade: a small group of strong trainers prepares the next level, who then prepare teachers. Support teachers after training through mentors, peer groups and short refreshers.
* Build material that works in many states. Keep the teaching approach, core skills, safety and assessment the same everywhere. Let language, local trades and examples change. Decide what to reuse, improve, build or stop using, including the material LAHI has built over twenty years, and make sure it works in schools with few resources. Keep one shared library, with one correct version of each resource and one person responsible for it.
* Release complete packages, and keep improving them. Each package has the student material, the teacher training to use it, and a way to check what students learned. Each must show what students will learn, what practical work helps, and what proves they learned it. You own their quality: try packages in real classrooms, learn from teachers and student work, and make the next version better.
* Use technology to do more with less manual work. For example: online modules for the knowledge part of training, AI-assisted drafts and translations checked by people, and simple phone tools for teacher support and observation.
* Work with state teams and state institutions. Our state teams bring real needs and deadlines from government. Work closely with them, and notice when several states need the same thing. Strengthen SCERTs, DIETs and district trainers so they can run day-to-day teacher training themselves, to the same standard.
Lead the team. Guide the team and specialists, and manage budgets and timelines. When states need different things at once, decide what comes first and explain why.  

**What success looks like:**

* Teachers use the material well in classrooms, and trainers can observe their work and help them improve.
* Students can show what they learned through practical work, not just that they did the activity.
* Material is reused across states without losing quality.
* States run more of the day-to-day training themselves.

**Who you will work with:**

  

Your closest partners are LAHI’s state teams. You will lead a small team, including a senior associate for teacher training, writers, instructional designers and designers, supported by subject and language specialists. Training reaches teachers through master trainers and state and district trainers. Outside LAHI, you will work with SCERTs, DIETs, state departments, boards, universities and local practitioners.

**What will be demanding:**

Several states may need different things urgently at once, and you will be asked to release work before it is tested. You will need to tell apart what one state needs now from what every state will need, keep quality while offering a practical way forward, and travel often to stay close to schools.

**About Lend A Hand India :**

For twenty years, Lend A Hand India has worked to make vocational education a real part of school learning. Our work reaches more than 20 states, 20,000 schools, 25,000 trainers and over 20 lakh students. India’s Economic Survey 2023–24 named our model as an example of how vocational education can work in schools. In many states, our teams work inside the state government as project management units.

Until now, we mostly ran programmes ourselves. Now we are becoming a resource organisation, helping governments run this work well on their own.

**Our Mission**

Equip School Students to Maximise Their Potential Through Skill Education

**Our Approach**
----------------

* Direct implementation in schools
* Partnership with central-state governments to define, and scale policy
* Building of Centres of Excellence that act as lighthouses for innovation
Resource organisation for the skilling ecosystem  

**Our Knowledge in Action**

Through the design & execution of innovative models from training centres, innovation hubs to mobile outreach initiatives, LAHI’s innovative knowledge resource drives both grassroots learning and systemic transformation across India. With 250+ LAHI staff embedded in state education systems across 20+ states, we provide technical and project management support, enabling governments to translate policy into action.

**Our Reach**

LAHI’s current scale of work includes -

* 20+ States and UTs
* 15000+ Schools
* 15 Lakh+ Students
250+ Team Members

  
  

### **Requirements**

**Who we are looking for**

* Most important: you have designed and run teacher training at scale, including training of trainers and master trainers, and you can watch a session and give feedback people can use the next day.
* About 12–15 years in teacher development, teacher education, curriculum or learning material, including leading a team.
* You know enough about curriculum and instructional design to set standards and judge whether material teaches well.
* You have worked with government education systems and worked to government timelines.
* You can find the common need behind many requests.
* You have managed external content partners and held their work to a clear quality standard.
You can see where digital and AI tools can save effort at scale, and where people must stay involved. You do not need to be a technical expert.  

Useful: vocational or skill education, more than one Indian language, university partnerships.

**How we will choose**

We will discuss one lesson from a middle-school vocational subject with you: what practical work helps, how a t

Teacher who is not a trade expert could run it, what shows learning, how to prepare trainers across a state, and which parts technology could handle. There is no model answer. We want to see how you think.

**Why join us**

You will shape how lakhs of teachers are prepared, at the moment vocational education enters every school in India. You will work with governments, not around them, and see your work used in many states. And you will build something designed to last.

title: Principal Technical Writer
description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.


Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.


**Your Role**

As a part of the User Assistance team, you will be responsible for creating quality documentation that helps users get the most out of their PTC product. You work closely with product design teams and help drive a consistent tone and voice across multiple documentation deliverables and products.


Your work involves writing about highly complex products and concepts, so you must have technical affinity.


You will also be involved in analyzing, reviewing and implementing SEO recommendations to provide customers with good experience


You will work with lead writers or UA managers to create, update, and maintain documentation for product releases for PTC products.


Ability to use AI\-enabled tools to support SDLC and knowledge or experience with AI, ML is an added advantage.

You will be responsible for developing and supporting user assistance deliverables for PTC products.


**Your Team**

You will be a part of the User Assistance team, reporting into a Manager. You will work with the product scrum teams and the lead/Principal writers in the Pune UA team.


**Your Day\-to\-Day**

* Create and update product documentation based on the assigned tasks, according to product release schedules.
* Apply PTC writing guidelines and documentation processes to be able to deliver user documentation of high quality as per PTC standards.
* Participate in daily standups; attend scrum meetings, product discussions, cross functional team meetings and so on.
* Support department initiatives.
* Collaborate closely with scrum teams for your product areas to gather information on product updates to be able to document it effectively.

Experience \- 7\+ Years

* Proficiency in technical writing and editing content.

Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting\-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.


If you share our passion for problem\-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?
